{{nihongo|'''Mishima Shrine'''|三島神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Echigo Province]].

'''Mishima Shrine''' (みしまじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Mishima–Ōyamazumi cult|ja|三島・大山祇信仰|qid=Q127948103}} {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Kashiwazaki, Niigata|ar|كاشيوازاكي (نييغاتا)|azb|کاشیوازاکی، نیقاتا|ce|Касивадзаки|ceb|Kashiwazaki Shi|de|Kashiwazaki|es|Kashiwazaki (Niigata)|fa|کاشیوازاکی، نیگاتا|fi|Kashiwazaki|fr|Kashiwazaki|gl|Kashiwazaki|id|Kashiwazaki, Niigata|it|Kashiwazaki|ja|柏崎市|ko|가시와자키시|mg|Kashiwazaki|ms|Kashiwazaki|mzn|کاشیوازاکی، نیگاتا|nl|Kashiwazaki|no|Kashiwazaki|pl|Kashiwazaki|pt|Kashiwazaki|ro|Kashiwazaki|ru|Касивадзаки|sv|Kashiwazaki|tg|Кашивазаки|tl|Kasyiwasaki|tr|Kashiwazaki|tt|Касивадзаки|uk|Касівадзакі|ur|کاشیوازاکی، نیگاٹا|uz|Kashivazaki (Niigata)|vi|Kashiwazaki, Niigata|war|Kashiwazaki, Niigata|zh|柏崎市|zh_classical|柏崎市|zh_min_nan|Kasiwazaki-chhī|zh_yue|柏崎|qid=Q633983}}, {{ill|Niigata Prefecture|Q132705|qid=Q132705}}.

=== History ===
This shrine is identified with Mishima Shrine in Mishima District of {{ill|Echigo Province|Q666514|qid=Q666514}}, listed as a Shikinaisha in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} compiled in {{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}}<ref>{{Cite book|和書|editor=教部省|author=|year=1925|title={{ill|Tokusen Jinmyōchō|ja|特選神名牒|qid=Q11571092}}|publisher=磯部甲陽堂|page=|isbn=|ref=}}</ref>. It was invited from {{ill|Ōyamazumi Shrine|Q703904|qid=Q703904}} on {{ill|Ōmishima Island|Q9009869|qid=Q9009869}} in {{ill|Iyo Province|Q907829|qid=Q907829}}, and is traditionally said to have been founded in {{ill|741|ab|741|af|741|als|741|am|741 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|741|ar|741|ary|741|arz|741|ast|741|az|741|azb|۷۴۱ (میلادی)|bar|741|be|741|be_x_old|741|bg|741|bn|৭৪১|bpy|মারি ৭৪১|br|741|bs|741.|ca|741|cdo|741 nièng|ceb|741|ckb|٧٤١|crh|741|cs|741|cv|741|cy|741|da|741|de|741|el|741|eml|741|eo|741|es|741|et|741|eu|741|fa|۷۴۱ (میلادی)|fi|741|fo|741|fr|741|frr|741|fy|741|ga|741|gan|741年|gd|741|gl|741|hak|741-ngièn|he|741|hi|741|hr|741.|ht|741 (almanak jilyen)|hu|741|hy|741|id|741|io|741|is|741|it|741|ja|741年|jv|741|ka|741|kaa|741|kk|741 жыл|ko|741년|la|741|lb|741|lij|741|lmo|741|lt|741 m.|lv|741. gads|map_bms|741|mdf|741|mg|741|mhr|741|mk|741|mr|इ.स. ७४१|mrj|741 и|ms|741|mzn|۷۴۱|nah|741|nap|741|nds|741|new|सन् ७४१|nl|741|nn|741|no|741|nrm|741|nso|741|oc|741|or|୭୪୧|os|741-æм аз|pl|741|pnb|741|pt|741|qu|741|ro|741|ru|741 год|rue|741|sa|७४१|scn|741|sd|741ع|sh|741.|shn|741|si|741|sk|741|sl|741|sq|741|sr|741|su|741|sv|741|sw|741|tg|Соли 741|th|พ.ศ. 1284|tk|741|tl|741|tly|741|tr|741|tt|741 ел|uk|741|ur|741ء|uz|741|vec|741|vi|741|war|741|wuu|741年|xmf|741|zh|741年|zh_min_nan|741 nî|zh_yue|741年|qid=Q23597}}<ref name=柏崎市三島神社/>.

It received devotion from the {{ill|Usami clan|Q24860892|qid=Q24860892}}, then from the {{ill|Nagao clan|Q1655561|qid=Q1655561|lt=Echigo Nagao clan}} (Uesugi clan), and successive lords of the {{ill|Takada Domain|Q839422|qid=Q839422}}<ref name=柏崎市三島神社>[https://www.city.kashiwazaki.lg.jp/soshikiichiran/sangyoshinkobu/shogyokankoka/kankosinko/23/25/3/3627.html 柏崎市名所案内「三島神社(みしまじんじゃ)」]（Kashiwazaki City）</ref>. According to the {{ill|Tokusen Jinmyōchō|ja|特選神名牒|qid=Q11571092}}, it was originally in Mishimatani village five ri east of Ishiji Station, and later moved to the current site.

In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} it became a prefectural shrine. However, due to later fire, it no longer retains the former appearance<ref name=柏崎市三島神社/>. The current shrine buildings were rebuilt in 1931<ref name=柏崎市三島神社/>.

In {{ill|1973|Q2477|qid=Q2477}}, it was designated a city cultural property (monument, historic site)<ref name=柏崎市三島神社/>.
